headline: Tech rout deepens as Nvidia loses its CEO and Anthropic's IPO pop fades
bottomLine: Nvidia's CEO exit, a record Anthropic IPO that gave back most of its pop, and an Asian chip sell-off hit AI assets, and bitcoin fell below $58,000. MoonPay filed for a federal bank charter, and Google booked a 2029 launch for its AI satellites.

portfolio.title: xAI fights California AI disclosure law as chemical spill and Grok suits pile up
portfolio.brief: xAI asked a US appeals court to block California's AI disclosure law; judges seemed skeptical. Thousands of gallons of chemicals spilled at its Southaven data center; Grok deepfake suits are mounting.
portfolio.impact: Law, environment and litigation risk now sit on the same asset as SpaceX's public float. A loss on disclosure would set precedent for every AI lab, and Grok agent misbehavior reports add product-safety risk.
portfolio.action: Ask SpaceX investor relations for Southaven clean-up exposure and the appeals-court timetable; bring the answers to the next partner call.

portfolio.title: SpaceX AI-chip debt sale reported at $32B; lenders wanted chips kept on Earth
portfolio.brief: Bloomberg reported a $32B sale of bonds tied to an Apollo-managed Nvidia-chip financing that SpaceX plans to lease, with yields above 8%. The FT says lenders wanted the chips restricted to Earth.
portfolio.impact: Lenders won't yet underwrite orbital compute, a hurdle for space data centers generally. Amodei calling SpaceX compute 'high quality' eases fears of an Anthropic exit, but SpaceX stock still fell with ANT.
portfolio.action: Ask SpaceX whether Anthropic's compute contract runs past Q2 2027 and how the lenders' on-Earth collateral limit changes its orbital-compute timeline.

portfolio.title: Anduril and HD Hyundai launch 600-ton ASV Alpha; Israel anti-drone bid reported
portfolio.brief: HD Hyundai and Anduril launched the 600-ton ASV Alpha on Nov. 16, and the Air Force awarded Anduril a counter-air missile launcher prototype. Anduril also joined the race to supply Israel with anti-drone defenses.
portfolio.impact: Hull production at a major shipyard, plus Air Force and Israeli work, shows Anduril scaling across maritime, air defense and exports instead of leaning on one program.
portfolio.action: Ask Anduril how many ASV Alpha hulls HD Hyundai can build in 2027 and whether the Israel counter-drone bid is in its plan; request answers by next week.

portfolio.title: Perplexity says it hit a $1B run rate and launches Orchestrator API
portfolio.brief: Perplexity says it reached a $1 billion revenue run rate, per its CEO's remarks, a company claim. It launched an Orchestrator API covering 45+ models and a Multiagent tool to coordinate frontier models.
portfolio.impact: The API makes Perplexity routing infrastructure for agents, not just a search app. The run rate helps its pricing, but the Anthropic IPO fade makes any round priced off AI multiples harder.
portfolio.action: Ask Perplexity whether the NVIDIA round still holds at its expected price after the ANT fade, and what share of the $1B run rate comes from the API.

thesis.title: US-approved chip licences for China sit undelivered as Chinese firms brace for curbs
thesis.brief: Mast says the US cleared 879,868 Nvidia H200 and AMD MI325X chips for Chinese firms across 21 applications as of May, all approved but not yet delivered. Chinese tech firms now brace for new US curbs.
thesis.impact: Chip access is set by licences and executive decisions, not markets, which is the policy-shock regime we described. It supports a premium on assets no state can seize.

thesis.title: Fed hike looms and bitcoin sinks below $58,000, against our debasement call
thesis.brief: Markets brace for another Fed hike; Bessent urged a smaller one, citing an energy shock. Bitcoin fell below $58,000, down 31.8% from Oct. 21, as Treasuries rallied on haven demand.
thesis.impact: Rising rates and a bid for Treasuries and cash are the opposite of 'money too loose', and bitcoin is trading as a risk asset. The 2027 sovereign-adoption call is untested, but near-term evidence runs against us.

thesis.title: Hormuz attacks escalate, but oil falls on supply as New York maps 5 GW of nuclear
thesis.brief: Iran's attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz escalated and another tanker was hit, while oil fell on robust supply. On Nov. 18 Gov. Hochul unveiled a plan to add 5 GW of new nuclear.
thesis.impact: The nuclear push is arriving through state policy, which supports the shift. Crude falling despite the attacks weakens the 'system in crisis' framing.

regulation.title: MoonPay applies for a national trust bank charter to issue stablecoins
regulation.brief: MoonPay filed with the OCC for a national trust bank in Miami Beach to issue and redeem stablecoins, hold crypto and manage reserves. The application is pending.
regulation.impact: MoonPay joins a rush of crypto firms seeking federal trust charters. That validates Erebor's route but narrows its edge, and political scrutiny of every applicant is growing.
regulation.next: OCC review under way; no decision date reported
regulation.action: Ask Erebor whether MoonPay's bid changes its stablecoin and custody timeline, and whether it would court MoonPay as a client.

regulation.title: CFTC says Hyperliquid and other onchain venues get no special rules
regulation.brief: CFTC Chair Michael Selig said onchain exchanges can offer derivatives to US traders if they obtain the required licences or work with a registered exchange.
regulation.impact: No carve-out for DeFi perps: US access runs through licences or partnerships, which favors compliant venues over offshore-style onchain trading.
regulation.next: Venues choose a licence or registered-exchange route; no deadline

regulation.title: Senate passes Death Bets Act banning prediction-market contracts on war and death
regulation.brief: Sen. Adam Schiff's bill bars US-regulated exchanges from listing contracts tied to war, terrorism, assassination or death. It now heads to the House.
regulation.impact: A narrow carve-out rather than a crackdown: Coinbase backs a CFTC proposal to treat event contracts as swaps, so mainstream products keep a path.
regulation.next: House takes it up next; no vote date set

tech.title: Anthropic raises $81B in record IPO, then gives back most of its debut pop
tech.brief: Anthropic raised $81.3B at $83 a share, opened near $111 on Nov. 19 and traded at $83.81 premarket on Nov. 20, barely above the offer price.
tech.impact: The first public price check on a frontier lab was a fast fade, a warning that late-stage AI valuations need revenue proof. Expect tougher pricing for Perplexity, Super Protocol and other AI rounds.
tech.action: Ask Super Protocol whether its US-entity term sheet valuation is being reset after the ANT fade, and review AI marks ahead of the next round.

macro.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang is out after a scandal and agrees to testify to the Senate

macro.impact: Key-man risk at the AI-chip leader is now political, tying export-control fights to one executive, and robotics loses its loudest champion. Expect volatility until a CEO is named.

frontier.title: SpaceX catches a Starship upper stage for the first time (Nov. 14)
frontier.brief: SpaceX caught the Starship upper stage on Nov. 14 in a historic first, after a booster malfunction ended a planned double catch attempt.
frontier.impact: Catching the ship, not just the booster, is a key step toward full reuse and cheaper launch. It reinforces SpaceX's cost lead over rivals such as Blue Origin.
